title: Cases of Stray Animal Abuse in Past Three Years
what_it_is: Cases of Stray Animal Abuse in Past Three Years

sections.label: Stray animal abuse cases
sections.summary: 12 animal abuse cases were substantiated with evidence and enforcement actions taken; no rising trend or common abuse types were seen, mostly stray cats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Upon investigation, 12 cases of animal abuse could be substantiated with evidence and enforcement actions were taken against the offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Based on the data, we do not see a rising trend in stray animal abuse cases and there are no common types of abuse observed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Most of the cases reported involved stray cats.

sections.label: First-time offender penalties
sections.summary: First-time offenders can face a maximum fine of $15,000, or up to 18 months' jail, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: First-time offenders can face a maximum fine of $15,000, or a jail term of up to 18 months, or both.

sections.label: Reported stray animal abuse evidence
sections.summary: Most reported stray animal abuse cases involved injured or dead animals found by the public, and NParks often lacked sufficient evidence of abuse.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: To the Member's other query, most of the reported cases of stray animal abuse involve injured or dead animals that were found by members of the public.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For many of these reported cases, NParks was unable to find sufficient supporting evidence and proof that they were cases of animal abuse.

sections.label: Reviewing Animals and Birds Act
sections.summary: The Animals and Birds Act is being reviewed, with internal and stakeholder consultations, including the penalty framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Indeed, we are reviewing the Animals and Birds Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We are consulting internally and will consult stakeholders when ready.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We assure Members that we are working on it, including the penalty framework.
